description: This file defines the DataGroup class, which models a data group in the OrangeHRM installer system. It includes properties for name, description, allowed permissions, and a list of data group permissions, along with methods for instantiation and accessors.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: Represents a data group in the installer, encapsulating its name, description, allowed permissions, and associated permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DataGroup instance with specified name, description, allowed permissions, and permissions list.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a DataGroup object from an array, parsing permissions and allowed permission data.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data group.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the data group.

methods.name: getAllowed
methods.description: Returns the AllowedPermission object associated with this data group.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of DataGroupPermission objects associated with this data group.
